argv:
unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /bin/sh -c 'set -eu
D=$(mktemp -d)
cleanup(){ rm -f "$D/codex_namespace_probe" 2>/dev/null || true; umount "$D" 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$D" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
mount -t binfmt_misc binfmt_misc "$D"
mount --make-private "$D"
printf "USERNS=%s\\n" "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/user)"
printf "MOUNTNS=%s\\n" "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/mnt)"
printf "MOUNTID=%s\\n" "$(stat -c %d:%i "$D")"
printf "UIDMAP\\n"
cat /proc/self/uid_map
printf "STATUS=%s\\n" "$(cat "$D/status")"
printf "ARCH=%s\\n" "$(uname -m)"
printf "MOUNTINFO\\n"
grep binfmt_misc /proc/self/mountinfo
printf "PRIVATE_ENTRIES_BEFORE\\n"
find "$D" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf "%f\\n" | sort
printf "%s\\n" ":codex_namespace_probe:M::\\x11\\x22\\x33\\x44:\\xff\\xff\\xff\\xff:/bin/true:F" > "$D/register"
test -f "$D/codex_namespace_probe"
printf "PRIVATE_ENTRY_BEGIN\\n"
cat "$D/codex_namespace_probe"
printf "PRIVATE_ENTRY_END\\n"
printf "READY\\n"
sleep 8
'
